name: @pipeworx/mcp-fcc-ecfs

tools.name: ecfs_search_filings
tools.description: Search FCC ECFS filings using the public API. Use filer to list filings submitted BY a specific company (exact name match); use query for full-text search across all filings. Returns filer/author, proceeding, submission type, dates, and official document links. Search matches are filings in the public record, not FCC findings or endorsements.

query.description: Full-text search across all ECFS filings — matches ANY mention of the term, not just filings BY that party.

filer.description: Filter to filings submitted BY this exact company or person name (e.g. "T-Mobile USA, Inc."). Use instead of query when searching for a specific filer's submissions.

_apiKey.description: Optional api.data.gov key for higher limits; defaults to DEMO_KEY.

tools.name: ecfs_docket_filings
tools.description: List FCC ECFS filings in an exact proceeding/docket, newest first, including documents and parties. A filing reflects the submitter’s position and is not an FCC decision.

_apiKey.description: Optional api.data.gov key for higher limits; defaults to DEMO_KEY.

tools.name: ecfs_filing_detail
tools.description: Retrieve one FCC ECFS filing by submission ID with all public proceedings, filers, authors, law firms, status, and official document/attachment URLs.

_apiKey.description: Optional api.data.gov key for higher limits; defaults to DEMO_KEY.

tools.name: ecfs_search_proceedings
tools.description: Search FCC ECFS proceedings/dockets by exact number or public API query and return descriptions, bureau, dates, and docket links.

_apiKey.description: Optional api.data.gov key for higher limits; defaults to DEMO_KEY.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-fcc-ecfs forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the fcc-ecfs pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
